---
title: "Newsletter"
description: "One email for each new issue."
---

Readers on the list get one email when a new issue of the Monitor or of Commentary is out: a short summary and a link to the full issue on this site. Nothing else is sent.

To join the list, write to the editor: editor@populiverse.com

The editor keeps the list himself. Your address is used only for these emails. To leave the list, write to the same address. See the [privacy page](../legal/privacy.qmd).
